summary.title: Vampires as fuel, drain as the engine: answers plus two loop families
summary.blurb: Trades combat lords and slow cards for cheap answers to the fast table, each-opponent death drains, Skullclamp and Teysa, and two loop families built on Pitiless Plunderer and Ashnod's Altar (Oathsworn Vampire, Reassembling Skeleton), with no two-card infinite.
